claude.manifest: Routes each subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider option names. For each routed Agent call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway options allow, each with its own key. The built-in general-purpose and claude agents send a fixed text in place of their description. The scope option picks the calls: core routes the four built-in agents, extended also routes user, project and plugin agents and sends their text. A config tool opens the plugin's own dialog to change the provider, gateway and scope options. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process Claude Code starts.
claude.catalogue: Routes each Claude Code subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider option names. On every Agent call it sends the subagent's task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway options allow, each with its own key. The built-in general-purpose and claude agents send a fixed text in place of their description.

omp.manifest: Routes Oh My Pi subagents to the smol, midl or slow model role and a thinking level that fits the task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. It sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, and the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow. The bundled task agent sends a fixed text in place of its description. The scope setting picks the agents: core routes the bundled task agent, extended routes every agent whose model you did not set. A project can set scope, and extended there can raise spend on the midl and slow roles. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process omp starts.
omp.catalogue: Routes each Oh My Pi task subagent to the smol, midl or slow model role and a thinking level that fits its task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. The plugin sends the redacted task text and the agent's description to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow. The bundled task agent sends a fixed text in place of its description.

openclaw.manifest: Routes OpenClaw subagent spawns to your small, middle or large model and an effort that fits the task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. For each routed sessions_spawn call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the spawn's one-line label, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow, each with its own key. The spawn of the requesting agent itself sends that agent's description when it has one and a fixed text when it has none. The plugin sets a model only from your small_model, middle_model and large_model settings. The scope setting picks the spawns: core routes the spawn of the requesting agent itself; extended also routes the spawns of other agents that set no model. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process OpenClaw starts.

hermes.manifest: Routes Hermes Agent delegated tasks to your small, middle or large model and an effort that fits the task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. For each routed task it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, and the task's context, shortened to fit, both with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow, each with its own key. It sends a fixed text in place of an agent description, and the task's description parameter, masked the same way and cut to 500 characters, when the delegating model sets one. The plugin sets a model only from your small_model, middle_model and large_model settings. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process Hermes starts.

descriptions.claude: Whose model scores a subagent call. typesafe: Jev from TypeSafe, the model the plugin's questions are fitted to. openai: OpenAI's decision model; costs more than Jev and its answers are not fitted. google: Google's decision model; costs more than Jev and its answers are not fitted; on a free-tier key Google may use the text.

descriptions.claude: How OpenRouter is used to reach the provider. direct: the provider's own API only. auto: the provider's own API, then OpenRouter if it fails. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then the provider's own API if it fails. openrouter: OpenRouter only. With auto or openrouter-first and both keys set, one call may reach both companies.

descriptions.claude: Which Agent calls the plugin routes. core: the built-in agents general-purpose, claude, Explore and Plan only. extended: also any Agent call that passes no model, including plugin and user agents, replacing the model and effort their definition sets. Forks and named calls stay unrouted.
descriptions.omp: Which subagents are routed. core: the task agent only. extended: every agent whose model you did not set, bundled agents included.
descriptions.openclaw: Which spawns are routed. core: the spawn of the requesting agent itself. extended: also the spawns of other agents that set no model.

commandContents.provider: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "provider" it asks the person whose model should score subagent calls and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its provider option in the plugin's settings.
commandContents.gateway: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "gateway" it asks the person how OpenRouter should be used for the provider and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its gateway option in the plugin's settings.
commandContents.scope: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "scope" it asks the person which agent calls the router should route and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its scope option in the plugin's settings.

typesafe.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe.description: Your TypeSafe API key. The plugin sends it to TypeSafe only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider option is typesafe and the gateway option allows TypeSafe's own API. The README says where to get one.

openai.title: OpenAI API key
openai.description: Your OpenAI API key. The plugin sends it to OpenAI only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider option is openai and the gateway option allows OpenAI's own API. The README says where to get one.

google.title: Google API key
google.description: Your Google API key. The plugin sends it to Google only, in the x-goog-api-key header of the scoring request, and only when the provider option is google and the gateway option allows Google's own API. The README says where to get one.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter.description: Your OpenRouter API key. The plugin sends it to OpenRouter only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the gateway option allows OpenRouter.

small_model.label: Small model
small_model.help: The model a spawn gets when the scoring model rates its task small, written as provider/model. Unset: such a spawn keeps the model OpenClaw would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.

middle_model.label: Middle model
middle_model.help: The model a spawn gets when the scoring model rates its task middle, written as provider/model. Unset: such a spawn keeps the model OpenClaw would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.

large_model.label: Large model
large_model.help: The model a spawn gets when the scoring model rates its task large, written as provider/model. Unset: such a spawn keeps the model OpenClaw would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.

typesafe.label: TypeSafe API key
typesafe.help: Your TypeSafe API key. The plugin sends it to TypeSafe only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider setting is typesafe and the gateway setting allows TypeSafe's own API. Unset: the plugin reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

openai.label: OpenAI API key
openai.help: Your OpenAI API key. The plugin sends it to OpenAI only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider setting is openai and the gateway setting allows OpenAI's own API. Unset: the plugin reads OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment.

google.label: Google API key
google.help: Your Google API key. The plugin sends it to Google only, in the x-goog-api-key header of the scoring request, and only when the provider setting is google and the gateway setting allows Google's own API. Unset: the plugin reads GEMINI_API_KEY from the environment, and never GOOGLE_API_KEY.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouter.help: Your OpenRouter API key. The plugin sends it to OpenRouter only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the gateway setting allows OpenRouter. Unset: the plugin reads OPENROUTER_API_KEY from the environment.

install.heading: OpenClaw
install.note: The npm package `{package}` exists only after its first publication. Review the source of the package before you run these commands: they carry `--force` and `--accept-capabilities`.
install.ciLine: CI installs the packed npm package on Ubuntu and checks that OpenClaw loads it.

small_model.label: Small model
small_model.help: The model a delegated task gets when the scoring model rates its task small, given as a dict that names a provider and a model. Unset: such a task keeps the model Hermes would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.

middle_model.label: Middle model
middle_model.help: The model a delegated task gets when the scoring model rates its task middle, given as a dict that names a provider and a model. Unset: such a task keeps the model Hermes would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.

large_model.label: Large model
large_model.help: The model a delegated task gets when the scoring model rates its task large, given as a dict that names a provider and a model. Unset: such a task keeps the model Hermes would give it, and the plugin still sets its effort unless you set one.

typesafe.label: TypeSafe API key
typesafe.help: Your TypeSafe API key. The plugin sends it to TypeSafe only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider setting is typesafe and the gateway setting allows TypeSafe's own API.

openai.label: OpenAI API key
openai.help: Your OpenAI API key. The plugin sends it to OpenAI only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the provider setting is openai and the gateway setting allows OpenAI's own API. Hermes's own OpenAI provider reads the same key and may use it for your own session. Set model.provider to keep another provider. The README, section Keys, says more.

google.label: Google API key
google.help: Your Google API key. The plugin sends it to Google only, in the x-goog-api-key header of the scoring request, and only when the provider setting is google and the gateway setting allows Google's own API. Hermes's own Gemini provider reads the same key, after GOOGLE_API_KEY, and may use it for your own session. Set model.provider to keep another provider. The README, section Keys, says more.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouter.help: Your OpenRouter API key. The plugin sends it to OpenRouter only, as the bearer token of the scoring request, and only when the gateway setting allows OpenRouter. Hermes's own OpenRouter provider reads the same key and may use it for your own session. Set model.provider to keep another provider. The README, section Keys, says more.

npm.name: @akurganow/model-router
npm.description: Routes subagents to a model and effort that fits the task, judged by a decision model from TypeSafe, OpenAI or Google. One package for OpenClaw and Oh My Pi.
